RID2Caltopo Apple app source and relinking materials offer

For each Apple app build distributed with this offer, UAS4SAR offers its
recipients the complete corresponding FFmpeg source, including any changes,
and the application object code, non-system link inputs, data and utilities
needed to modify FFmpeg and relink the application under LGPL 2.1 section 6(c).
The corresponding Eigen source and applicable license notices are included.

This offer is valid for at least three years after our last distribution of
the corresponding build. We provide these materials free of charge. Use the
build-specific GitHub download linked from License & Notices. Downloads are
public and require no GitHub account. The download identifies the matching
application code, dependencies and build inputs; later builds may share it
when those materials are unchanged.

If the download is unavailable or you need another way to receive a copy,
request the materials from kjt@uas4sar.com. Identify the app version/build and,
when available, the material identifier shown on its GitHub release page.
GitHub availability does not limit our obligation to fulfill this offer.

The materials retain their respective open-source licenses and modification
rights. Apple development tools, SDKs, original signing keys and provisioning
profiles are not included. Use your own compatible tools and signing setup
to install a modified executable.
